description: This file defines the PutawayRule class and associated functions for managing warehouse putaway rules, including validation, capacity checks, rule application, and serial number handling within an ERP system.

classes.name: PutawayRule
classes.description: Represents a warehouse putaway rule with validation and capacity management.

methods.name: validate_duplicate_rule
methods.description: Checks for duplicate putaway rules for the same item and warehouse.

methods.name: validate_priority
methods.description: Ensures the rule's priority is at least 1.

methods.name: validate_warehouse_and_company
methods.description: Validates that the warehouse belongs to the specified company.

methods.name: validate_capacity
methods.description: Checks if the warehouse capacity can accommodate current stock levels.

methods.name: set_stock_capacity
methods.description: Calculates and sets the total stock capacity based on conversion factor and capacity.
